proposal: Two-storey rear extension and internal alterations to a grade II listed cottage

pages.text:
Site: 2 Mill Cottages, Eastmere
Dwelling: grade II listed end-of-terrace cottage, 2 bedrooms
Proposal: two-storey rear extension; internal alterations
Parking: none on site

The extension projects 3.4 m beyond the rear wall of the outshut.
Walls in reclaimed brick, slate roof at 35 degrees.
The rear parlour wall is opened by 2.1 m to join the extension.
